kpi.title: Category KPIs
kpi.description: Month-to-date sales, target pace, forecast, margin, stock, cover and availability for all categories, each manager and each category, for all countries and each country. Reads v_kpi.
kpi.sql: select * from v_kpi order by case level when 'total' then 0 when 'manager' then 1 else 2 end, manager nulls first, scope

brand.title: Brand performance
brand.description: Each brand's month-to-date sales against its target, forecast gap, margin, cover and short lines. Reads v_brand.
brand.sql: select * from v_brand order by mtd_sales desc

sku.title: Item cover by hub
sku.description: Every active item in every hub, with its country of origin: stock, days of cover, inbound POs, expiry risk, status and the suggested action. Reads v_sku.
sku.sql: select item_code, hub, country, description, category, manager, brand, uom, status, days_cover, cover_incl_inbound, cover_min, cover_max, avg_daily_qty, unr_qty, soh_value, inbound_qty, next_eta, at_risk_value, expired_value, blocked_value, days_to_expiry, mtd_sales, gm_pct, action, expired_qty, expired_unit_cost, at_risk_qty, at_risk_unit_cost from v_sku where status <> 'Inactive' order by soh_value desc

daily.title: Month to date by day
daily.description: Cumulative sales this month against a straight-line target and the same days last year, per view and country. Reads v_daily.
daily.sql: select * from v_daily order by scope, day

monthly.title: Sales by month this year
monthly.description: Monthly sales, target and last year for the current year, per view and country. Reads v_monthly.
monthly.sql: select * from v_monthly order by scope, month

aging.title: Stock aging
aging.description: Stock value by remaining shelf life and by days since receipt, per view and country. Reads v_aging.
aging.sql: select * from v_aging order by scope, basis, bucket_order

channel.title: Sales by segment
channel.description: Month-to-date sales and margin by customer segment against the same days last year, per view and country. Reads v_channel.
channel.sql: select * from v_channel order by scope, mtd_sales desc nulls last

customers.title: Top customers vs usual pace
customers.description: The 25 largest customers per view, this month against their average of the three months before, pro-rated to today, per country too. Reads v_customers.
customers.sql: select * from v_customers order by scope, prev3_avg desc

leak.title: Sales under margin floor
leak.description: Customer and item combinations this month sold more than 3 points under the category margin floor. Reads v_margin_leak.
leak.sql: select row_number() over (order by gp_gap desc)::int leak_id, * from v_margin_leak order by gp_gap desc

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: 3-letter country code and name for each country of origin the brands come from.
countries.sql: select code, name from country where code in (select country_code from brand) order by code

alerts.title: Exceptions to act on
alerts.description: Every rule that needs someone to act (stock-outs, low cover, expiry, overstock, delayed POs, target and margin gaps, lapsing customers), ranked by severity and money at stake. Reads v_alerts.
alerts.sql: select * from v_alerts order by alert_id
